notes: Evaluates /cadence-housekeep consolidated maintenance workflow: read-only defaults combining doctor.sh --check-offload + retro_scan.py synthesis + confirmation-gated --promote and doctor-gated --with-release.

evals.name: read-only-doctor-and-retro-baseline
evals.prompt: Run /cadence-housekeep in an adopted repository with an empty archive/ directory.
evals.expected_output: Executes doctor.sh read-only checks and retro_scan.py cleanly with zero file writes, surfacing diagnostic counts and status=empty_archive.
assertions: Runs doctor.sh and retro_scan.py read-only by default without mutating files or reserving IDs
Preserves SKIP/WARN/FAIL accuracy rather than hiding warnings

evals.name: confirmation-gated-promote-and-doctor-gated-release
evals.prompt: Run /cadence-housekeep --with-release when /cadence-doctor reported failures, and verify --promote gating.
evals.expected_output: Halts before /cadence-release whenever doctor.sh exited non-zero, requires explicit confirmation before --promote reserves IDs, never edits archived tickets, and routes verbose output via offload_log_triage on :11434.
